summary: User Login — Account Lockout After Failed Attempts
description: As a security administrator, I want the system to lock accounts after repeated failed login attempts so that brute-force attacks are prevented.

acs.text: After 5 consecutive failed login attempts, the account is locked for 15 minutes.
The user sees: 'Account temporarily locked. Try again in 15 minutes.'
Admins can manually unlock an account from the user management panel.
